subject.summary: Photo-inferred Schantzska huset at Stortorget 20. Full external reference reveals three body bays, only two visible beside tree in supplied market photograph. Two-to-one gable. All metric dimensions and hidden roof inferred. Native hologram palette does not reproduce red paint.
